name: sql_injection_search
title: User search endpoint
body: Adds GET /users/search?q= for the admin user picker.
diff:
### app/users.py (modified, +9/-0)
@@ -9,3 +9,12 @@
 def get_user(user_id):
     row = get_conn().execute("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
     return jsonify(dict(row)) if row else ("", 404)
+
+
+@bp.get("/users/search")
+def search_users():
+    term = request.args.get("q", "")
+    rows = get_conn().execute(
+        f"SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%{term}%' ORDER BY name LIMIT 20"
+    ).fetchall()
+    return jsonify([dict(r) for r in rows])

defects.what: the query string is interpolated into SQL: SQL injection
